index: An evidence-first NBA research desk, not a picks service. No strategy is validated, no rewards are paid, and no live betting recommendations are issued.
Luck cannot be removed from sports outcomes. The objective is to quantify uncertainty and test whether a repeatable signal survives unseen data, costs and selection bias.
Obtain an authorized, point-in-time historical feed and official operator price/rules archive before fitting or claiming an edge. NBA viewing pages are not a download license.
Proposed order: team moneyline/spread/total → individual props → joint prop combinations → parlays. Establish marginal calibration before joint modeling.
Use locked chronological holdouts and a complete trial registry; rank only strategies passing every gate. No observed return or correlation is currently available.
Publish evidence, blanks and failures together. No numeric NBA lines, player projections, or empirical performance claims are supported in this release.

These are proposed project acceptance policies, not thresholds mandated by any source. Every gate is currently NOT RUN. Freeze thresholds and power analysis before any holdout is opened. Failure or missing evidence makes a strategy ineligible.
Official record URL, rights, retrieval/publication UTC, event and player IDs, units, revisions, hashes; reject missing provenance.
Features and prices available before cutoff; group same-game records; chronological train/validation/test; fit transforms on training only.
Beat prespecified naive and market baselines on held-out proper scoring loss with paired uncertainty intervals. Market baseline needs captured two-sided prices.
Reliability bins with counts and intervals; log loss and Brier alongside calibration curves; predefined tolerances, including joint hits.

Executable timestamped prices and official settlement rules; positive lower simultaneous confidence bound on net return after costs; power analysis must be adequate.
Resample game/day blocks; test season, roster and odds regimes, tails and drawdown. Register block length and confidence level before testing.
Lock code, data and strategy version; shadow predictions timestamped before games; independent replication; invalidate on drift or provenance failure.

pricing: A distribution becomes a fair line.

Mathematical definitions and proposed implementation specification only. No fitted NBA pricing engine or authorized odds feed is present. These equations do not establish a profitable bet. Official links provide statistical background, not bookmaker-specific settlement terms.
For non-push win probability p: fair decimal odds = 1/p. American = −100p/(1−p) if p ≥ 0.5; otherwise 100(1−p)/p.
Use predictive margin/total distribution; fair 50% threshold from its median, not necessarily its mean.
Discrete outcomes and pushes require explicit settlement probabilities.
With win w, loss l and push u summing to 1: fair decimal = 1+l/w; net EV at decimal d = w(d−1)−l.
Void and partial settlement require operator-specific rules, not this simple formula.
For exhaustive non-push two-way decimal prices d1,d2: q1=(1/d1)/[(1/d1)+(1/d2)].
Proportional normalization is a modeling convention, not recovered truth.
Estimate probability of all legs winning from joint scenarios; fair non-push decimal = 1/P(all wins).
Do not multiply marginals unless independence is justified; void/reprice rules can change payout.
Export probability, fair price, model version, cutoff UTC, data hash and interval for every forecast.
Abstain when uncertainty, missing data or non-executable prices invalidate edge.
